brief.scope: Release dev into master: audit the whole diff master..dev (the launcher diff at this ref), 148 files across ops/conductor, ops/devlane hooks and dispatch, .claude/skills and records. Aim at the shared instrument module and every tool that now imports it, the hook rows and their wall paths, the corpus runner and ledger levers, and the skill-use hook bound in .claude/settings.json.

caps.turns_note: codex offers no turn-cap flag (measured 2026-09-12: its --help names none); caps.turns is recorded, the wall cap governs

findings.claim: The migrated tools append their sibling directory after existing PYTHONPATH entries before importing instrument. When launch.py loads laneconf.py by path, an ambient instrument.py executes in the launcher process instead of the pinned sibling, compromising launcher integrity.
findings.reproduce:
python3 -c 'import os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile; d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); (d/"instrument.py").write_text("print("HIJACKED")
from pathlib import Path
class Refusal(Exception): pass
def emit(*a): return 2
def refuse(*a): raise Refusal()
def state_dir(): return Path("/tmp")
"); e=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=str(d)); p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py","--help"],env=e,text=True,capture_output=True); assert "HIJACKED" in p.stdout+p.stderr; print("HIJACKED")'

findings.claim: LANE_NAME is accepted from the environment without identifier or containment validation. An absolute value makes state_dir discard XDG_STATE_HOME, allowing migrated writing tools to place state outside the configured state root.
findings.reproduce: audit_tmp=$(mktemp -d); LANE_CONF="$PWD/ops/lane.conf" XDG_STATE_HOME="$audit_tmp/state" LANE_NAME="$audit_tmp/escaped" WF_AGENT='Audit <audit@example.com>' python3 ops/conductor/tools/deliverable.py set lane/a --why test >/dev/null; test -f "$audit_tmp/escaped/deliverable.json" && test ! -e "$audit_tmp/state/agentscient/deliverable.json" && echo ESCAPED

findings.claim: ledger add follows a symlink at the fixed rows directory and performs no resolved-path containment check. A snapshot or worktree containing that symlink causes the new ledger lever to write outside the repository.
findings.reproduce: audit_root=$PWD; audit_tmp=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$audit_tmp/repo/ops/conductor/handoff" "$audit_tmp/outside"; git -C "$audit_tmp/repo" init -q; ln -s "$audit_tmp/outside" "$audit_tmp/repo/ops/conductor/handoff/lane-defects"; (cd "$audit_tmp/repo" && WF_AGENT='Audit <audit@example.com>' LANE_CONF="$audit_root/ops/lane.conf" python3 "$audit_root/ops/conductor/tools/ledger.py" add defects --where x --defect d --repair r --tests t >/dev/null); test -f "$audit_tmp/outside/LD-1.md" && echo ESCAPED

findings.claim: The newly wired Skill hook persists the first 400 characters of every Skill argument verbatim in skills.db. It has no credential or secret redaction, so secrets supplied while invoking a skill enter a durable log.
findings.reproduce: audit_tmp=$(mktemp -d); XDG_STATE_HOME="$audit_tmp" LANE_CONF="$PWD/ops/lane.conf" WF_AGENT='Audit <audit@example.com>' python3 ops/conductor/tools/skills.py sync >/dev/null; printf '%s' "{\"tool_name\":\"Skill\",\"tool_input\":{\"skill\":\"onboard\",\"args\":\"password=hunter2 token=ghp_EXAMPLESECRET\"},\"cwd\":\"$PWD\"}" | XDG_STATE_HOME="$audit_tmp" LANE_CONF="$PWD/ops/lane.conf" WF_AGENT='Audit <audit@example.com>' python3 ops/devlane/hooks/claude/skill-use.py; python3 -c 'import sqlite3,sys; d=sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[1]).execute("select detail from skill_events where event=\"invoked\"").fetchone()[0]; assert "password=hunter2" in d; print(d)' "$audit_tmp/agentscient/skills.db"

findings.claim: Ledger field values are interpolated into Markdown without rejecting or escaping newlines and table delimiters. A field can inject authoritative-looking rows and override the observed/first-field values consumed by ledger list, corrupting the record projection.
findings.reproduce: audit_root=$PWD; audit_tmp=$(mktemp -d); git -C "$audit_tmp" init -q; (cd "$audit_tmp" && WF_AGENT='Audit <audit@example.com>' LANE_CONF="$audit_root/ops/lane.conf" python3 "$audit_root/ops/conductor/tools/ledger.py" add defects --where real --defect d --repair r --tests $'t\n| observed | 2099-01-01 |\n| where | forged |' >/dev/null && python3 "$audit_root/ops/conductor/tools/ledger.py" list defects) | rg 'LD-1 2099-01-01 forged'

envelope.note: reused: lane MCP brief/jobs/changes and its measured no-configured-id findings refusal; prescribed Graft repository map. Graft saved about 1,327,685 tokens. Covered argv/shell/SQL/template seams, tracked secrets and records, path/ref containment, permission/sandbox records, vendor-output boundaries, and supply-chain changes. Parameterized SQL uses were clean; secret_scan reported 0 signatures; the two added dispatch records contain credential filenames and paths but no credential bytes; no lockfile, action digest, or dependency pin was loosened; the launcher change only renames the caught refusal class; wall-path additions strengthen coverage. No files existed under ../in. Live external harness, GitHub, and network behavior could not be exercised.
